narrative.overview: Apple gallery grammar applied to healthcare software: near-invisible UI, generous air, one idea per full-bleed tile. Neutral white and parchment surfaces, near-black tiles at night; the colour change is the divider. Valentia logo blue is the only action colour and crimson is emphasis, once per view.
keyCharacteristics: Flat pill buttons; press scales to 0.96.
SF Pro on Apple devices, Inter elsewhere; body 17px.
Centred headings, alternating white/parchment tiles, no section borders.
No decorative gradients or UI shadows.

rules.name: The One Action Rule
rules.body: Signal blue marks what can be acted on. If it is blue and not interactive, it is wrong.

rules.name: The Crimson Ration Rule
rules.body: Crimson appears at most once per viewport as emphasis. Two crimson moments in one screen cancel each other out.

rules.name: The Ramp Not Hex Rule
rules.body: Components reference the ink ramp (--color-v-ink-*), never a literal neutral, so both themes stay correct from one token set.

rules.name: The One Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: A mono uppercase eyebrow appears once per page, in the page hero. Section headings stand on their own.

rules.name: The Weight Not Size Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy inside a section comes from weight and ink step, not from adding a larger size.

rules.name: The Lift Means Live Rule
rules.body: Only interactive surfaces lift on hover. A card that lifts must go somewhere or do something.

dos: Do take every colour and type size from src/styles/tokens.css.
Do keep signal blue for actions and crimson for a single emphasis per screen.
Do check every new surface in both themes; light is the default.
Do honour prefers-reduced-motion for every reveal, lift and loop.
Do give uneven collections a grid that leaves no empty cell.
donts: Don't add an eyebrow above section headings; one per page, in the hero.
Don't number unordered collections ("01", "02"); numbers are for real sequences only.
Don't use em dashes in visible copy.
Don't use pure black shadows or warm greys.
Don't give two buttons with the same destination different labels.
Don't auto-advance content (captions, carousels); the reader moves it.
Don't add section-wide radial glow washes; surfaces stay quiet.
Don't repeat the same collection as cards in two sections; map it once.
